context: Doctor explains a clinical-trial result to a curious teen student
purpose: Teach: 療法/強力/圧倒的/振興/大衆/勢力/動向/報酬

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、ニュースで新しい療法が出たって言ってたけど、本当にそんなに効くの?
lines.en: Doctor, the news said a new therapy came out — does it really work that well?
lines.style: curious teen leaning forward with genuine scientific interest

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: うん、今回の治験結果は圧倒的で、従来の薬よりはるかに強力な効果が出たんだよ。
lines.en: Yes, this trial's results were overwhelming — the effect was far more powerful than the conventional drug.
lines.style: measured doctor sharing exciting data with careful precision

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、すごい!じゃあもう大衆向けに普及するってこと?
lines.en: Whoa, amazing! So it'll be rolled out to the general public already?
lines.style: wide-eyed teen jumping ahead with eager optimism

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: そう急がないで。学会内でも賛成派と反対派の勢力がまだ拮抗していてね。
lines.en: Don't rush. Even within the academic community, the pro and con factions are still evenly matched.
lines.style: gently restraining adult tempering the teen enthusiasm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、お医者さんの世界もそういう動向があるんだ。
lines.en: Huh, so even the doctors' world has those kinds of trends going on.
lines.style: thoughtful teen processing a new layer of reality

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: うん、それに国の振興策で研究費が増えたから、競争もかなり激しいんだ。
lines.en: Right, and since national promotion policies boosted research funding, the competition is pretty intense too.
lines.style: candid mentor pulling back the curtain on the field

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 研究者って、論文を出したら報酬がもらえるの?
lines.en: Do researchers get a reward when they publish a paper?
lines.style: naive teen asking a blunt practical question

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 直接ではないけど、評価や昇進という形で報われるよ。地味だけど大事な仕事さ。
lines.en: Not directly, but it comes back as recognition and promotions. It's quiet work, but important.
lines.style: warm doctor closing with humble professional pride
